VanG is a D-Ala-D-Ala ligase homolog that can synthesize D-Ala-D-Ser an alternative substrate for peptidoglycan synthesis that reduces vancomycin binding affinity in Enterococcus faecalis.

Tet(32) is a tetracycline resistance gene similar to Tet(O) and binds to the ribosome to confer tetracycline resistance as a ribosomal protection protein.
mef(E) is a proton motive efflux pump in Streptococcus pneumoniae that confers resistance to macrolides. It is found on the same operon as mefA and the ABC-efflux pump mel.
